rows: In general, polyamides exhibit very good resistance to all kinds of chemicals. Apart from concentrated acids, only very few reagents attack polyamides.
Class statement for polyamides; the PA identity is an unspecified polyamide, so only class-level statements are recorded for it.
Water or aqueous solutions at high temperature

All polyamides take up water when kept in a moist environment. At room temperature this is a physical process which is reversible. Irreversible chemical damage to the material can only be caused by water or aqueous solutions at high temperatures. This is referred to as hydrolysis.
